title: Amur Tiger Re-identification
description: Amur Tiger Re-identification in the Wild (ATRW) is a computer-vision benchmark dataset containing images of 92 individual Amur tigers from 10 zoos in China, packaged with ~9,500 bounding boxes, pose keypoints, and ~3,600 individual identity labels. Data are split into detection, pose-estimation, and re-identification tasks with train/val/test partitions matching those used in the ICCV 2019 Workshop on Computer Vision for Wildlife Conservation challenge.
